_comment: Setups written from a community's own channel (build_catalog.py turns each into a template: the named mods plus what they strictly need, ordered by the catalog's rules). 'pack' picks one pack of a mod.

setups.name: Beastmen - Community Beastmen
setups.description: Play a Beastmen herd with **Community Beastmen**: matched (sex) battle animations, corrupted elves and other custom units, slaves as a resource, mercenaries and mission chains that capture and corrupt female legendary lords, who then join as heroes or lords. Built from the mod's Discord channel and its maintainer's guide.
highlights: Mission chains that capture and corrupt female legendary lords
Endo's matched animations, more often with More Animation
Only for Khazrak, Malagor, Taurox and Morghur

recommends.note: the author used it in his own Beastmen playthrough
faster travel to the quest targets (several players)
base mod of dd_bst; players use it with Community Beastmen
Marks of the Wild upgrades paid with Breeding Slaves
brings back the elf captives on shields
the maintainer's own Tomb Kings repack, recommended in his guide: Tomb Kings are the reskin he finds most important, and CB removed their mounts so the animations play
the game takes only one merged audio bank, so several of Endo's reskins need this merge to keep their voices (Endo)
Endo's Empire reskin: female infantry as targets for the matched animations (the maintainer: Endo's reskins of other factions work as long as they do not reskin the Beastmen)

Zeta's faction pack: the maintainer recommends the separate Warmaidens faction packs, all except the beastwoman one; needs only the resource packs, not the all-in-one conversion; its Slaanesh spawn and fiend summons show texture bugs, the community's no-spawn repack on the channel avoids them

Zeta's faction pack: the maintainer recommends the separate Warmaidens faction packs, all except the beastwoman one; needs only the resource packs, not the all-in-one conversion; its Chaos pack and CB both reskin the Tzeentch Centigors (an overlap the maintainer calls unavoidable)

Zeta's continuation of Endo's matched animations (most-skeletons pack, 2026-10-22): it holds all of Community Beastmen's animation files plus about 190 more pairings and new DLC units. The app loads it below Community Beastmen, so Community Beastmen keeps its own animation tables and this pack only adds the ones Community Beastmen lacks; above it, it would drop Community Beastmen's newer entries. Not discussed in the channel yet; the warning against other animation mods is about those shared tables

avoid.note: turns the Beastmen themselves into women, while Community Beastmen's matched animations pair Beastmen with female enemies; it also distorts minotaurs and doombulls (maintainer)
no effect: Community Beastmen points the Ungors to its own models (its corrupted elves already use Endo's female Ungor model)
the Slaanesh version is for Slaanesh and Warriors of Chaos campaigns, not for a Beastmen one
its Dark Elf pack has a texture conflict with Community Beastmen; the maintainer uses [Endo] Dark Elves instead
Endo's Unit Idles conflict with the matched animations (the patches shifted its animation slots like the matched entries); no other animation mods next to Community Beastmen (maintainer)

its Female Ungors part replaces the game's standard Ungor model, so every Ungor unit that does not use Community Beastmen's own models turns female – and Ungors play the Beastmen's matched animations; take Endo's single faction reskins instead (file comparison 2026-11-03)
the maintainer's list for the full version names the Slaanesh Vassal mod: it can stop the third capture mission from firing (one modder reports no problem with an older version)
a fix of Vassal Dilemmas, which the maintainer's list for the full version names

setups.description: Play the Greenskins with **Goblin Horde Redux**: slaves, events and ancillaries for any Greenskin lord, plus the Goblin Enslaver lord. Built from the goblin-whored Discord channel.
highlights: Slave and event mechanics for any Greenskin lord

setups.name: Corrupted Ascension (Lin) - Miao Ying
setups.description: Lin's standalone corruption campaign for **Miao Ying** on Lin's own Generic Framework - an alternative to Lazy's corruption mods, not combinable with them or with the mods built on them (Azazel's Realm, Temptation's Bloom, Corrupted Landmarks). Built from the mod's Discord channel.
highlights: Miao Ying's corruption on Lin's own framework
Not combinable with Lazy's corruption mods
English texts with Lin's AllInOne translation

recommends.note: same author and framework, independent of Corrupted Ascension; covered by the AllInOne translation
same author: roguelike exploration for all factions; covered by the AllInOne translation since 2026-10-10

setups.name: Imrik - Dragon Taming
setups.description: A small story for playing **Imrik** of Caledor: taming dragons (MrDustV's maintained version). Lazy's corruption framework and Azazel's Realm must be off. Built from the mod's Discord channel.

recommends.note: in the list of the modder who keeps the pack alive (2025-02-19), among the mods that change the elves and Miao Ying
